elements.label: Figure 3.1: Poverty rates by dimensions revealing chronic poverty
elements.description:
Four line-chart panels of poverty rate (%) for 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018 and 2020, with values printed on the points. Note: poverty rate according to the $3.20/day 2011PPP poverty line. Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010–2020.

Panel 'Region' (y-axis 0–50):
- Central Highlands: 29.6, 25.8, 27.6, 20.4, 19.7, 17.1
- Midlands & Northern Mountains: 39.9, 34.0, 32.8, 23.4, 22.0, 16.0
- Northern & Coastal Center: 18.6, 13.6, 12.1, 9.0, 6.2, 4.7
- Mekong Delta: 14.3, 11.5, 6.8, 4.5, 2 (2018), 3.7
- Red River Delta: 8.6, 4.8, 3.6, 1.4, 1.2, 0.6
- Southeast: 5.3, 3.0, 2.3, 0.4, 0.4, 0.6

Panel 'Household engagement in agriculture' (y-axis 0–50):
- No agriculture: 6.9, 3.9, 2.3, 1.1, 0.7, 1.0
- Some agriculture: 14.0, 10.1, 7.8, 4.9, 4.3, 4.7
- Only agriculture: 35.2, 29.1, 29.3, 23.5, 22.7, 21.3

Panel 'Urban vs rural' (y-axis 0–60):
- Rural: 22.1, 16.9, 15.3, 10.8, 9.4, 7.0
- Urban: 4.4, 3.7, 2.8, 1.3, 1.0, 1.5

Panel 'Ethnicity' (y-axis 0–60):
- Ethnic minority: 56.8, 47.7, 46.8, 35.9, 34.6, 27.2
- Kinh: 9.4, 6.4, 4.6, 2.1, 1.1, 1.2

Pattern: poverty falls in every group over 2010–2020, with the steepest declines in the Midlands & Northern Mountains and among ethnic minorities and rural households; the Only agriculture and Rural/Ethnic minority groups stay highest throughout.
